arabic text: ZINDANN SE JAB RIHA HUE SADATE KARBALA\nMAA NE LIPAT K QABRE SAKINA PE DI YEH SADA\nUTHO SAKINA CHALE KARBALA
english translation text: When the Sayyids of Karbala were released from prison,\nthe mother clung to Sakina's grave and cried:\nrise, Sakina—let us return to Karbala.

arabic text: CHOTI SI TURBAT PE MAA NE KAHA
english translation text: At the tiny grave, the mother said:

arabic text: ZINDAN SE JATA HAI AB QAFLA
english translation text: The caravan is now leaving the prison.

arabic text:
MUJHE SHAHZADI TUMHARI QASAM
NA RAKHUN GI ZINDAN SE BAHIR QADAM
SAFAR KI AB HOTI HAI TAYARIAN
AMARI MEI BETHE HAI AHL E AZA
GHURBAT KA MERE TUMHE WASTA
english translation text:
My princess, by your oath,
I will not step outside the prison without you.
Preparations for the journey have begun,
and the mourners sit within the camel-litters.
For the sake of my loneliness, rise.

arabic text:
WOH PEHLE K JESE TO GHURBAT NAHI
AYE BIBI HAMARI WOH HALAT NAHI
TUMHE SHAMIYON SE AB AYE MERI JAAN
KAFAN MANGNE KI ZAROORAT NAHI
LO MIL GAI HAI TUMHARI RIDA
english translation text:
We are no longer in the condition we were before.
O Lady, our state is no longer the same.
My beloved, you will no longer need
to beg the people of Shaam for a shroud.
Your chadar has now been returned.

arabic text:
MUJHE YAAD ASGHAR KI HAI BABASI
LAHAD SE WOH MAYAT NIKALI GAI
AKELE MEI REHNE NA DUN GI TUMHE
BHAROSA NAHI SHAMIO KA KOI
REHTE HAI CHARO TARAF ASHQIAN
english translation text:
I remember Asghar's helplessness,
when his body was removed from the grave.
I will not leave you here alone;
I do not trust the people of Shaam,
for oppressors surround you on every side.

arabic text: YEH SHAMI KAHAN TUMKO BEHLAI GAY\nTUMHARI LAHAD PER NAHI AI GAY\nRAHAY GA ANDHERA HI ZINDAN MEI
english translation text: Where will these people of Shaam console you?\nThey will not come to your grave.\nThe prison will remain dark.

arabic text: HARAM JAB YAHAN SE CHALE JAI GAY\nKON AI GA PHIR JALANE DIYA
english translation text: When the sacred family leaves this place,\nwho will come again to light a lamp?

arabic text:
KAHANI PADAR GI SUNAO GI MEI
AGAR NEEND AI SULAO GI MEI
AKELE NA NAQE PE BETHU GI TUM
TUMHAY SATH APNAY BITHAO GI MEI
AB TO RASAN MEI NA HOGA GALA
english translation text:
I will tell you your father's story,
and when sleep comes, I will put you to sleep.
I will not sit alone upon the camel;
I will seat you beside me.
Now your throat will not be bound in rope.

arabic text:
MUJHE MAAR DAALE GA BUS YAHI GHUM
QAMAR HAI BETE TUMHARI TUKHAM
WARAM BAZOU KA MUJHE YAAD HAI
TUMHE TO DIKHAI BHI DETA HAI KAM
AKBAR SE BIBI MILE GI SHIFA
english translation text:
This grief alone will kill me:
my child, your back has become bent.
I remember the swelling upon your arms,
and how little you can now see.
Akbar will grant you healing, Lady.

arabic text:
BARI DAIR TEHRI HAI DARBAR MEI
YAHAN PER NA ROKO ZIYADA UNHE
K PEHLU PE EK HATH RAKHE HUE
SADA DE RAHI HAI SAKINA TUMHE
LENE KO AI HAI KHUD SAYEDDA
english translation text:
She stood for so long within the court.
Do not delay them here any longer.
With one hand placed upon her wounded side,
the Sayyida herself calls you, Sakina.
She has come to take you.

arabic text:
THI ZINDAN MEI AKBER AJAB WOH GHARI
REHAI PE ROTI THI HER EK PHOOPI
IDHER KHOON ROTA THA ABID UDHAR
SAKINA LAHAD MEI TARAPTI RAHI
JAB BHI YEH MADAR NE RO KER KAHA
english translation text:
O Akbar, what a strange hour it was within the prison.
At the moment of freedom, every aunt wept.
Abid wept blood on one side,
while Sakina writhed within the grave
whenever her mother cried these words.
